name: tree-sitter: simple pipelines and lists
source:
whoami | cat
cat foo | grep -v bar
a | b && c && d; d e f || e g

name: tree-sitter: while loop with multi-command condition
source:
while something happens; do
  echo a
  echo b
done

name: tree-sitter: for in loop over variable and literals
source:
for x in a b c; do
  echo $x
done

name: tree-sitter: C-style arithmetic for loop
source:
for ((a = 0; a < 10; a++)); do
  echo $a
done

name: tree-sitter: if statement with elif and else branches
source:
if a; then
  b
elif c; then
  d
else
  e
fi

name: tree-sitter: case statement with patterns and body
source:
case a in
  b)
    c
    ;;
  d | e)
    f
    ;;
esac

name: tree-sitter: function definitions both with and without keyword
tree-sitter: subshell and brace group compound commands
tree-sitter: variable expansions simple, braced, and command substitution
tree-sitter: redirections file, descriptor duplication, and heredoc
source:
cmd < input > output 2>&1 <<EOF
heredoc body
EOF
